title: Font registry
description: spec/fonts.json: an array of registry entries. A registry, not an allowlist (Decision 5).

family.description: Family name spelled exactly as Canva font library spells it.

weights_used.description: CSS weights the library actually uses from this family.

category.description: Broad classification used by pairing rules.
category.$comment: No vocab file: font classification is registry-internal, not frontmatter vocabulary.

source.description: Where the family comes from: google, fontshare, adobe, foundry name, or system.

license.description: License string, for example OFL-1.1 or a commercial licence reference.

canva_native.description: Whether Canva ships the family. Decision 5: validate warns, never fails, on no or unverified.

canva_fallback.description: Family Canva substitutes when this one is absent. Wrap widths are computed against Inter metrics regardless.

fallback_weight_map.description: Flat weight remapping as "<source>:<fallback>" strings, for example "350:400". Flat list, not a map (Decision 2).

optical_size_note.description: Optical-size caveats, for example a separate Display cut above a size threshold. "-" when none.
